changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table nomenclature_definition ( id uuid not null, name varchar(255) not null unique, description varchar(500), active boolean not null, primary key (id) );

create table nomenclature_definition_level ( id uuid not null, nomenclature_definition_id uuid not null, position integer not null, name varchar(100) not null, primary key (id), constraint uk_nomenclature_definition_level_position unique (nomenclature_definition_id, position) );
alter table nomenclature_definition_level add constraint fk_nomenclature_definition_level foreign key (nomenclature_definition_id) references nomenclature_definition (id);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists nomenclature_definition_level cascade;
drop table if exists nomenclature_definition cascade;
